The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. By the tide of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The jade is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the haven. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
